semiconductor_relevance: High — Ceramdis specializes in high-performance ceramics used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Ceramdis GmbH is a Swiss company that produces customer-specific components made from various advanced ceramic materials, including silicon nitride and silicon carbide. With over 25 years of experience, they offer solutions for both small and large parts, including prototypes and series production, tailored to the needs of the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Custom ceramic components in silicon nitride, silicon carbide, zirconium oxide, and aluminum oxide
Planning and production of assemblies and subassemblies
Individual customer consulting and product development

regional_presence.Switzerland: Ceramdis is based in Switzerland, leveraging its location for high-quality manufacturing and customer service.
